description: This PHP source file defines a console command class `InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand` for the OrangeHRM system. The class manages the installation process on a new database, including obtaining user input for database configuration, performing system checks, creating database and users, and running database migrations. It extends `InstallerCommand` and uses the Symfony Console component for interaction.

classes.name: InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class that manages installation of OrangeHRM on a new database, including configuration, system check, creation steps, and migrations.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method invoked when the command runs; manages early exit conditions and calls executeCommand.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Performs the sequence of steps to install OrangeHRM on a new database, including license acceptance, database setup, system check, instance setup, admin user creation, and launching the installer process.

methods.name: getAppSetupUtility
methods.description: Provides an instance of AppSetupUtility to perform database and migration operations.

methods.name: licenseAcceptance
methods.description: Prompts user to accept license terms before proceeding.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Requests database configuration details from the user and validates connection and existence.

methods.name: systemCheck
methods.description: Performs system environment checks required for installation and validation, allowing to continue or abort.

methods.name: instanceCreation
methods.description: Collects organization and regional details for setting up the OrangeHRM instance.

methods.name: adminUserCreation
methods.description: Prompts for admin user details and registration consent, storing data for later use.

methods.name: installation
methods.description: Coordinates the complete installation process, including database creation, permission checks, migrations, configuration file creation, and final setup.
